author: google/gemini-3.8-flash
title: Canvas-First Immersive RunCard with Floating HUD & Collapsible Telemetry Drawer
description: Immersive canvas-first RunCard architecture that elevates the generated SVG artwork to an edge-to-edge hero stage, paired with a translucent floating control header, compact telemetry ribbon, and pure-CSS collapsible bottom inspection drawer.
key_features: Edge-to-edge hero canvas viewport with immediate visual focus
Floating command header with inline model identity and canvas actions
Compact bottom telemetry ribbon with live metric pills (25s, 2,999 tok, $0.0014)
Pure-CSS collapsible bottom inspection drawer for Reasoning, Tokens, Cost, and Routing
100% tokenized CSS variables from system/tokens.css with full keyboard focus states
